blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Purpose: Multi-organ segmentation using deep learning requires large amounts of annotated patient data, which are often unavailable at individual institutions. Privacy constraints further limit data sharing, while the labor-intensive nature of annotation leaves substantial amounts of local data unlabeled. We propose a flexible semi-supervised federated multi-task student–teacher (FedMust) framework that leverages both labeled and unlabeled data across participating sites within a federated learning (FL) setting for multi-organ segmentation. Methods: At each communication round, clients with labels for the same task form a federation to train an aggregated teacher model. These teacher models generate task-specific features for all data at each client. Subsequently, all clients form another federation to train a multi-task student model comprising a shared encoder and task-specific decoders that replicate the teacher-generated features across segmentation tasks. The aggregated student model is then used to update the local teachers for the next training round. Results: Extensive experiments demonstrated that FedMust outperformed local and federated single-organ models, yielding an average performance gain of approximately 13% across clients ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 ). The experiments also demonstrated the impact of multi-task learning and unlabeled data and the applicability of the framework in relaxing labeled-data requirements for client participation. Conclusion: FedMust provides a flexible approach for federated multi-organ segmentation by leveraging distributed labeled and unlabeled data while relaxing the requirements for labeled data for client participation in the federation.
blocks.zh: 目的:利用深入学习的多器官分化需要大量附加说明的病人数据,而个别机构往往得不到这些数据。 隐私限制进一步限制了数据共享,而注释的劳动密集型使得大量本地数据没有标签。 我们提出一个灵活的半监督联合多任务学生-教师(FedMust)框架,这个框架在联合学习(FL)设置内,在参与的网站上利用标注和无标签的数据进行多组织分解。 方法: 在每轮交流中,具有相同任务标签的客户组成一个联合会,培训一个汇总的教师模式。 这些师范模型为每个客户端的所有数据生成任务特定特征. 随后,所有客户都组成另一个联合会,以培训一个多任务学生模式,其中包括一个共享编码器和任务特定解码器,这些解码器将师生生成的功能复制到分区任务中. 然后使用汇总学生模式更新当地教师,以便进行下一轮培训。 结果: 广泛的实验表明,FedMust的绩效优于当地和联邦的单一机构模型,使客户的平均业绩收益约为13%(p < 0.01 p < 0.01)。 这些实验还证明了多任务学习和无标签数据的影响以及该框架在放宽客户参与的标签数据要求方面的适用性。 结论:FedMust通过利用分布式标签和无标签数据,为联邦多组织分解提供了灵活的方法,同时放宽了客户参与联邦的标签数据要求.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The use of deep learning techniques for organ segmentation has improved the accuracy and robustness of multi-organ segmentation models; however, such methods typically require substantial amounts of annotated data Fu et al. (2021) ; Tajbakhsh et al. (2020) . Data annotation is time-consuming and labor-intensive, resulting in only a small portion of existing data in institutions being annotated and utilized for segmentation. Moreover, many institutions lack the resources required for multi-organ annotation, while their available labels are fragmented across different clinical fields. In such cases, data sharing among institutions is also prevented due to patient data privacy constraints. To mitigate data scarcity and privacy concerns, federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising solution by enabling collaborative model training on larger, more diverse datasets without sharing raw data. In FL, a group of clients train models on their local data and share only model parameters or updates with a trusted server, which aggregates them to obtain a global model with improved generalizability McMahan et al. (2017) . Consequently, FL has become a viable approach in digital health Rieke et al. (2020) , with applications in cancer detection Pati et al. (2022) ; Sheller et al. (2019) ; Moradi et al. (2025b) ; Moradi et al. (2024) ; Moradi et al. (2025a) and medical image segmentation Xu et al. (2021) ; Sheller et al. (2020) . Despite its potential, FL faces challenges in real-world implementation Kairouz and McMahan (2021) ; Li et al. (2020) , particularly in healthcare settings where data and model heterogeneity arise from variations in data volume, acquisition protocols, imaging modalities, and data distributions across clients Ma et al. (2024) ; Sheller et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh: 采用深层学习技术进行器官分解提高了多器官分解模型的准确性和稳健性;然而,这种方法通常需要大量的附加说明的数据Fu等人(2021);Tajbakhsh等人(2020)。 数据注释费时费力,导致只有一小部分现有机构的数据被注释并用于分类。 此外,许多机构缺乏多器官注释所需的资源,而它们现有的标签则分散在不同临床领域。 在这种情况下,由于病人数据隐私的限制,各机构之间的数据共享也受到阻碍。 为了减少数据稀缺和隐私问题,联邦学习已成为一个很有希望的解决办法,它促成在不分享原始数据的情况下,对更大、更多样化的数据集进行协作模式培训。 在FL中,一群客户端在本地数据上对模型进行训练,并且只与一个可信赖的服务器共享模型参数或更新,该服务器将其聚合,以获得一个全球模型,其通用性得到改进的McMahan等人(2017年). 因此,FL已成为数字健康Rieke等人(2020年)的一个可行方法,应用于癌症检测Pati等人(2022年);Sheller等人(2019年);Moradi等人(2025b年);Moradi等人(2024年);Moradi等人(2025a年)和医疗图像分化Xu等人(2021年);Sheller等人(2020年)。 尽管FL具有潜力,但它在现实世界的执行方面面临挑战Kairouz和McMahan(2021年);Li等人(2020年),特别是在医疗保健环境中,数据和模型异质性产生于数据量、获取协议、成像模式以及客户Ma等人(2024年)的数据分布的变化;Sheller等人(2020年).

blocks.en: Most FL segmentation approaches require fully annotated datasets for client participation; however, in real-world scenarios, such data are not available. To address this, semi-supervised FL techniques have been proposed to enable participation and leverage partially annotated data. Semi-supervised organ segmentation has been studied in both centralized and federated settings Huang et al. (2020) ; Fang and Yan (2020) ; however, multi-task approaches that address inconsistent annotations remain limited Zhang et al. (2021) . Early foundational work established a baseline for multi-organ and tumor segmentation from non-overlapping labels Shen et al. (2022) , but demonstrated that the aggregated global model can drift from local models due to task heterogeneity. To mitigate such knowledge conflicts, various frameworks have been proposed, including loss function design Shi et al. (2021) , double-teacher training with knowledge distillation Zhan et al. (2023) , adaptive server aggregation to penalize clients with higher conflicts Du et al. (2025) , and combinations of such approaches Wang et al. (2023) . Moreover, architectural designs with task-specific encoders Xu et al. (2023) and decoders Kim et al. (2024) mitigate knowledge conflicts among tasks; yet, they require prior knowledge of all tasks before training and annotations for at least one task per client, respectively. Combining these approaches can further improve the performance and generalizability of FL under partially labeled data Deng et al. (2025) ; Tölle et al. (2025) . However, many multi-task semi-supervised FL methods still fail when no group of clients shares a common annotated task, and the impact of the typically predominant unlabeled local data remains largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: 多数FL分解方法都需要有充分说明的数据集供客户参与;然而,在现实世界中,没有这种数据。 为了解决这一问题,已提议采用半监督的FL技术,以便能够参与和利用部分附加说明的数据。 在集中式和联合式两种场合都研究了半监督器官分化 Huang等人(2020年); Fang和Yan(2020年);然而,处理不一致说明的多任务方法仍然有限 Zhang等人(2021年)。 早期的基础工作为非重叠标签的多器官和肿瘤分化确定了基线 沈等人(2022年),但证明汇总的全球模型由于任务不均匀,可以从本地模型中漂移. 为了减少这种知识冲突,提出了各种框架,包括损失函数设计Shi等人(2021年),双重教师培训,以及知识提炼。 Zhan等人(2023年),适应性服务器聚合,惩罚冲突较高的客户Du等人(2025年),以及此类方法的组合Wang等人(2023年). 此外,有特定任务编码器的建筑设计 徐等人(2023年)和解码员金等人. (2024) 减轻任务之间的知识冲突;然而,在培训和说明之前,每个客户至少分别需要事先了解所有任务。 结合这些方法可以进一步提高部分标注数据Deng等人(2025年);Tölle等人(2025年)的FL性能和通性. 然而,许多多任务半监督的FL方法仍然失败,因为没有一组客户分担共同附加说明的任务,而典型的主导性无标签的本地数据的影响基本上仍未得到探讨。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a flexible, semi-supervised, federated multi-task student-teacher (FedMust) framework that trains a multi-organ segmentation model using a mixture of labeled and unlabeled data from clients. This approach employs a feature-matching technique to extract maximal information from partially labeled and unlabeled client data. FedMust then trains a student model with a shared encoder and frozen task-specific decoders, thereby placing greater emphasis on learning task-agnostic and generalizable features while preventing deviation from the task-specific teacher models. Iteratively training and updating the teacher and student models in this manner improves the overall multi-organ segmentation performance across clients. The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We propose a flexible, semi-supervised federated multi-task learning framework for multi-organ segmentation that operates through the iterative training of student and teacher models. • We introduce a feature-matching strategy that distills information from partially labeled and unlabeled local data to enhance segmentation performance, along with a single-encoder, multi-decoder student model that generalizes segmentation features while retaining task-specific performance. • We conduct extensive experiments to investigate the impact of multi-task learning and the inclusion of unlabeled data from other clients. Evaluation on two unseen test sets demonstrates improved performance compared with models trained in isolation. • We present an ablation study to further investigate the impact of incorporating unlabeled data from the local clients themselves and the contribution of an additional client without annotated data to the FL process.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出一个灵活的,半监督的,联合的多任务学生-教师(FedMust)框架,利用来自客户的标签和无标签数据的混合物来培训一个多器官分块模型. 这种方法采用特征匹配技术,从部分标签和未标签客户端数据中提取最大信息. 联邦 然后必须培训一个学生模型,配备一个共享的编码器和冻结的任务特定解码器,从而更加强调学习任务不可知性和可概括性,同时防止偏离任务特定教师模型. 以这种方式对教师和学生模式进行纵向培训和更新,可改善客户之间整体的多组织分化表现。 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出一个灵活的、半监督的多任务联合学习框架,通过对学生和教师模式的迭代培训来运作。 我们采用了一种特征比对策略,从部分标签和无标签的本地数据中提取信息,以提高分解性能,同时采用单一编码器,多解码器的学生模式,将分解性特征概括化,同时保留特定任务性能. 我们进行了广泛的实验,以调查多任务学习的影响,以及纳入其他客户未贴标签的数据。 对两套隐形测试进行的评价表明,与单独培训的模型相比,业绩有所改善。 我们提出一项延期研究,以进一步调查纳入当地客户自己未贴标签的数据的影响,以及一个没有附加说明的客户对财务责任进程的贡献。

The findings are discussed in Section 5 , and concluding remarks are provided in Section 6 .

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: Consider a set of clients that aim to collaboratively train a model for multi-task abdominal organ segmentation over a known set of tasks. In this setting, each client possesses only a small amount of annotated data for a subset of the tasks, while the majority of its data remains unlabeled. Restricted by privacy constraints, the clients cannot directly share their data to train a centralized model. Furthermore, since the sets of labeled tasks available across clients do not necessarily overlap, traditional FL cannot be directly employed. Training models independently at each client is also limited by the scarcity of annotations required to perform segmentation across the entire set of tasks.
blocks.zh: 考虑一组客户端,旨在合作训练一种模式,在已知的一系列任务上进行多任务腹部器官分化. 在这个设置中,每个客户端只拥有少量附加注释的数据,用于一个子集的任务,而其大多数数据仍然没有标记. 受隐私限制,客户端无法直接共享数据来训练集权模型. 此外,由于客户之间可以使用的有标签的成套任务不一定重叠,因此不能直接使用传统的FL。 每个客户的独立培训模式也因缺少说明而受到限制,说明需要在整个一组任务中进行分割。

The segmentation of each abdominal organ is considered a separate task, denoted by k ∈ 𝒦 k\in\mathcal{K} , where 𝒦 \mathcal{K} represents the set of all segmentation tasks. Each client possesses partially labeled data, i.e., annotations are available for only a subset of the tasks. We denote the subset of tasks for which annotations are available at client i i by 𝒦 i ⊆ 𝒦 \mathcal{K}_{i}\subseteq\mathcal{K} . Furthermore, 𝒩 i k \mathcal{N}_{i}^{k} and 𝒩 ¯ i k \bar{\mathcal{N}}_{i}^{k} denote the sets of labeled and unlabeled data available at client i i for task k k , respectively. The set of clients with annotated data for task k k is denoted by 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} , and these clients are eligible to participate in the federated training of the corresponding teacher model.

blocks.en: The teacher features are defined as the outputs of the teacher model immediately before its final fully connected layer. For further clarification, see the teacher model illustrated in Figure 1 . Following feature generation, student training is initiated, where each client i ∈ 𝒞 i\in\mathcal{C} constructs a student model as a multi-decoder 3D U-Net architecture. The student model consists of a shared encoder and multiple task-specific decoders, with each decoder corresponding to a specific task. Unlike the teacher models, the student decoders exclude the final fully connected layer. The architectures of the teacher and proposed student models are illustrated in Figure 1 .

blocks.en: The student model is defined by two sets of parameters: the shared encoder parameters 𝐖 S i En ​ ( r ) \mathbf{W}_{\text{S}_{i}}^{\text{En}}(r) and the task-specific decoder parameters 𝐖 S i De ​ ( r , k ) \mathbf{W}_{\text{S}_{i}}^{\text{De}}(r,k) . For each task k k , the corresponding aggregated teacher decoder parameters are transferred to the student decoder, 𝐖 T FL De ​ ( r , k ) → 𝐖 S i De ​ ( r , k ) \mathbf{W}_{\text{T}_{\text{FL}}}^{\text{De}}(r,k)\rightarrow\mathbf{W}_{\text{S}_{i}}^{\text{De}}(r,k) , and subsequently frozen during student training. The student model is then trained by optimizing the shared encoder to minimize the mean squared error (MSE) between the features generated by the student and those produced by the corresponding teacher models. This encourages the shared student encoder to learn more generalizable features, while the frozen task-specific decoders constrain deviation from the teacher models. blocks.en: 3 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验结果

blocks.en: For the experimental setup, we consider a scenario involving four institutions that aim to collaborate in a privacy-preserving manner to perform multi-organ abdominal CT segmentation. The scenario comprises four clients, each possessing annotations for a single-organ CT dataset. Specifically, clients C1, C3, and C4 possess CT images and corresponding annotations for 131 liver, 281 pancreas, and 41 spleen scans from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon challenge Antonelli et al. (2022) , respectively. Client C2 holds 210 labeled kidney CT images from the KiTS19 challenge Heller et al. (2019) . The annotations for the left and right kidneys are grouped together under a single annotation label, and kidney segmentation in this study refers to the segmentation of both kidneys. The available data are partitioned using five-fold cross-validation, with 80% used for training and 20% for validation in each fold. Table 1 summarizes data and annotation availability for each task and client.
blocks.zh: 就实验性设置而言,我们考虑一种设想,即四个机构旨在以保护隐私的方式进行合作,进行多器官CT分裂。 设想包括4个客户,每个客户都有单机构CT数据集的说明. 具体来说,客户C1,C3和C4分别拥有131个肝脏,281个胰腺的CT影像和相应的说明,以及41个来自医学分会Decathlon挑战安东内利等人(2022年)的脾脏扫描. 客户端C2持有来自KitS19挑战海勒等人(2019年)的210个标注肾脏CT图像. 左肾和右肾的注解在单注标签下组合在一起,本研究中的肾分化是指两个肾的分化. 现有数据采用五倍交叉验证法进行分割,每叠80%用于培训,20%用于验证. 表1汇总了每项任务和客户的数据和备注。

blocks.en: Table 1: Data distribution for training, validation, and testing across clients and the independent test set. Label availability for each task (liver, kidney, pancreas, and spleen) is indicated by ✓ \boldsymbol{\checkmark} , while label absence is indicated by × \boldsymbol{\times} .
blocks.zh: 表1:培训、验证和测试数据在客户之间和独立测试集之间的分布。 每个任务(肝脏、肾脏、胰腺和脾脏)的标签可用性由\\ boldsymbol\ checkmark}表示,而标签缺缺则由\ boldsymbol\times}表示。

blocks.en: The objective of each institution is to train a model capable of segmenting all four organs. Due to privacy restrictions, centralizing the data is not feasible, while traditional FL approaches are not applicable when no group of clients shares annotations for the same task. The proposed FedMust algorithm addresses this limitation by enabling the development of a multi-task organ segmentation model across such clients. The resulting model is then compared with conventional FL and client-specific models trained in isolation on local data. The trained models are evaluated on two independent test sets containing annotations for all tasks: AMOS Ji et al. (2022) (276 cases) and TotalSegmentator Wasserthal et al. (2023) (626 cases). For both datasets, only cases with non-empty annotations for all four organs are included in the test set. Evaluation on these out-of-distribution test sets provides insight into the generalizability of the trained models and their ability to learn representations beyond client-specific features.
blocks.zh: 每个机构的目标是培训一个能够将所有四个机构分开的模式。 由于隐私限制,将数据集中起来是不可行的,而传统的FL方法在没有一组客户共享同一任务的说明时不适用. 拟议的FedMust算法通过在这类客户中开发一个多任务器官分割模型来解决这一限制。 然后,将由此产生的模型与传统的FL和针对客户的模型进行比较,这些模型是在孤立地接受当地数据培训的。 对经过培训的模型进行了两个独立的测试,其中包含所有任务的说明:AMOS Ji等人(2022个案例)和TotalSegmentator Wasserthal等人(2023个案例)。 对于这两个数据集,只有对所有四个器官都有非空注的病例才被列入测试集. 对这些分配外测试的成套评价使人们深入了解训练有素的模型的通用性及其学习客户特定特征以外表述的能力。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the proposed multi-task semi-supervised student–teacher training framework in an FL network with four clients. Each client has labeled data for a single organ (C1: liver; C2: kidney; C3: pancreas; C4: spleen). The proposed training procedure is illustrated in four steps.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 由四个客户组成的FL网络中拟议的多任务半监督学生-教师培训框架概述。 每个客户端都有单器官(C1:肝脏;C2:肾脏;C3:胰腺;C4:脾脏)的标签数据. 拟议的培训程序有四个步骤。

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes the workflow of the proposed FedMust algorithm for the described scenario. The process begins in Step 1 by training a 3D U-Net model on the available labeled data at each client. This is followed by Step 2, in which the trained teacher models are used to generate features for all available labeled and unlabeled data across tasks. In Step 3, a 3D U-Net-based multi-decoder student model is then trained to replicate these features while its decoders remain frozen. The hypothesis is that incorporating features from unlabeled data improves the overall performance of the organ segmentation models, while freezing the student decoders during training prevents the model from drifting away from the task-specific teachers and allows the shared encoder to learn task-agnostic features. Finally, in Step 4, the teacher models are updated, and another round of FL is initiated.
blocks.zh: 图2总结了上述情景的拟议FedMust算法的工作流程。 这一过程从步骤1开始,在每一个客户端的现有标签数据上培训一个3D U-Net模型. 随后是步骤2,其中训练有素的教师模型用于生成所有可用的、有标签和无标签的跨任务数据的特性。 在第三步中,一个基于3D U-Net的多解码器学生模型随后被训练来复制这些特性,同时其解码器仍然被冻结. 该假说认为,从未贴标签的数据中加入特征可以改善器官分解模型的整体性能,同时在训练中冻结学生解码器可以防止模型漂移离开任务特定教师,并允许共享编码器学习任务不可知特征. 最后,在第四步中,更新了教师模型,并启动了另一轮FL.

blocks.en: 3.1 Pre-processing and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.1 预处理和执行细节

blocks.en: All experiments were implemented in Python 3.10 and conducted on an NVIDIA A40 GPU with 48 GB of memory, using CUDA 12.4 on Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS. The encoder-decoder models were designed and implemented using MONAI 1.4.0. Prior to model training, the images were pre-processed by resampling to a uniform voxel resolution of 1.5 ​ mm × 1.5 ​ mm × 3.0 ​ mm 1.5\,\mathrm{mm}\times 1.5\,\mathrm{mm}\times 3.0\,\mathrm{mm} , cropping to 128 slices of 224 × 224 224\times 224 voxels each, and clipping the image intensities to the 1st–99th percentile range, followed by intensity normalization.
blocks.zh: 所有实验均在Python 3.10中进行,并使用带有48GB内存的NVIDIA A40 GPU进行,在Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS上使用CUDA 12.4. 编码器-解码器模型是使用MONAI 1.4.0设计和实施的. 在模型训练之前,通过将图像重新取样到1.5毫米×1.5毫米×3.0毫米1.5\,\mathrm{mm}\times 1.5\,\mathrm{mm}\times 3.0\,\mathrm{mm},裁剪到128片,每片224×224×224小时224伏克塞尔,将图像强度剪切到1-99百分位范围,然后强度正常化.

blocks.en: During training, data augmentation was performed using random flipping along the first spatial axis and random 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} rotations, each applied with a probability of 0.5. The Adam optimizer was used for training with an initial learning rate of 0.01 and linearly reduced to 10 − 5 10^{-5} . For FL aggregation, FedAvg was used to aggregate the models proportionally to each client’s dataset size. The batch size was set to 4, with each epoch iterating over all mini-batches. For all experiments, the local models were trained for E=300 iterations, which was sufficient for convergence. To ensure a fair comparison, the FL experiments were configured with the same total number of training iterations, using E=30 local iterations per communication round for R=10 communication rounds. Performance was evaluated using the 3D Dice score, with 95% confidence intervals estimated through bootstrap resampling with a sample size of b = 1000000 b=1000000 . All reported metrics were computed based on the ensembled performance of the five-fold cross-validated models. The ensembled model generates segmentation predictions by averaging the prediction maps obtained from the five corresponding cross-validated models.
blocks.zh: 在训练期间,采用沿第一个空间轴随机翻转和随机90 ∘ 90 ^{\circ}旋转来进行数据增强,每一次应用概率为0.5. 亚当优化器被用于培训,初始学习率为0.01,线性降低到10−5 10^{-5}. 对于FL聚合,FedAvg被用来按照每个客户端的数据集大小按比例汇总模型. 批量大小设定为4个,每个时代都在所有的小型炮管上徘徊. 在所有实验中,当地的模型都接受了E=300迭代的培训,这足以实现趋同。 为确保公平比较,FL实验的配置与培训迭代总数相同,每轮通信使用E=30本地迭代,R=10次通信迭代. 利用3D Dice分数评价了性能,通过靴子重新取样估计了95%的置信间隔,样本大小为b=1000000 b=1000000. 所有报告的指标都是根据五倍交叉验证模型的全方位性能计算的。 综艺模型通过平均从五个相应的交叉验证模型中获得的预测图来生成分解预测.

blocks.en: Table 2: Ensembled Dice performance of the models trained using five-fold cross-validation and evaluated on the independent AMOS (top) and TotalSegmentator (bottom) test sets, reported with 95% confidence intervals. The table illustrates the impact of the proposed model, particularly its ability to leverage unlabeled data from other clients to improve segmentation performance.
blocks.zh: 表2:使用五倍交叉验证方法培训的模型的嵌入性能,并在独立的AMOS(顶部)和TotalSegmentator(底部)测试集上进行评估,报告时置信间隔为95%。 该表说明了拟议模型的影响,特别是其利用其他客户未贴标签的数据改善分块性能的能力。

blocks.en: 3.2 Multi-tasking and Partially Labeled Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 多任务和部分标签数据

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , clients possess partially labeled data, meaning that each client has labels for only a subset of the available tasks. In this section, we investigate the impact of utilizing unlabeled data from other clients, through the multi-task training of FedMust, on improving the segmentation performance for specific tasks. The proposed FedMust algorithm is employed to train a model that provides segmentation capabilities across all clients and tasks. To evaluate its performance, we compare the Dice scores for organ segmentation with those obtained by local models trained independently at each client, as conventional FL fails in this setting. To further highlight the impact of the amount of unlabeled data from other clients on performance, we repeated the experiment with varying amounts of labeled data available at each client. This allows us to isolate the effect of incorporating additional unlabeled task data from other clients during student training on the final performance. Thus, the performance gains achieved by FedMust as a function of the amount of local labeled data and unlabeled data from other clients are obtained.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,客户端拥有部分标注的数据,这意味着每个客户端只有一组可用任务的标签. 在本节中,我们通过FedMust的多任务培训,调查利用其他客户提供的未加标签的数据对改善具体任务的分区性能的影响。 采用拟议的FedMust算法来培训一个提供所有客户和任务的分块能力的模型. 为了评价它的性能,我们比较了器官分化的Dice分数和每个客户独立训练的本地模型获得的分数,因为常规的FL在此情况下失败. 为了进一步突出其他客户端未加标签的数据数量对性能的影响,我们重复了每个客户端可获得的不同数量标签数据的实验. 这使得我们能在学生最后表现培训期间,从其他客户中分离纳入更多无标签任务数据的效果. 因此,FedMust作为本地标注数据和其他客户未标注数据数量的函数而实现的性能收益是获得的.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the ensembled performance of the 5-fold cross-validated models, together with their 95% confidence intervals. As shown, FedMust outperforms the local models, particularly when the local models exhibit poor performance. The observed performance gains of FedMust indicate that multi-task segmentation, through the incorporation of unlabeled data from other clients into the federation during student model training, further refines the feature extraction capability of the student encoder. This is more clearly demonstrated for the C4: Spleen client, where, due to the limited number of labeled samples, the same 41 samples are used in the last three experiments. As a result, the trained local models achieve identical performance, while FedMust continues to improve by leveraging additional unlabeled data from other clients. Incorporating unlabeled data from other clients results in a more generalizable shared multi-task encoder through student training.
blocks.zh: 表2报告5倍交叉验证模型的综艺表现,以及95%的置信间隔. 如所示,FedMust优于当地模型,特别是在当地模型表现不佳时. FedMust观察到的性能收益表明,在学生模式培训期间,通过将其他客户未贴标签的数据纳入联邦,多任务分割,进一步完善了学生编码器的特征提取能力. 这在C4:脾属客户端中得到了更明确的证明,由于标签标本数量有限,在最后三次实验中使用了相同的41个标本. 因此,训练有素的本地模型实现了相同的性能,而FedMust则通过利用其他客户提供的更多无标签数据继续改进. 将来自其他客户的未贴标签的数据纳入其中,通过学生培训,形成一个更普遍的共享多任务编码器。

blocks.en: The qualitative performance of the proposed FedMust algorithm for multi-organ segmentation is illustrated in Figure 3 . As illustrated, clients trained in isolation can only provide segmentations for tasks for which labeled data are locally available, whereas FedMust enables multi-organ segmentation with improved performance across all tasks. This improvement can be observed by comparing the multi-organ segmentation predictions with the corresponding ground-truth annotations.
blocks.zh: 图3说明了拟议的多器官分解FedMust算法的质量性能。 如前所述,接受单独培训的客户只能为贴有标签的数据可在当地获得的任务提供分块,而FedMust则能够使多器官分块,改进所有任务的业绩。 这种改进可以通过比较多器官分解预测和相应的地面真实说明来观察.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Qualitative performance on representative test cases from the AMOS and TotalSegmentator datasets. The first column shows the CT images with their corresponding ground-truth annotations. The subsequent client columns show predictions from the local models, which are limited to the tasks annotated at each client. The last column shows FedMust predictions for all tasks, demonstrating improved segmentation performance across all tasks.
blocks.zh: 图3:AMOS和TotalSigmentator数据集中代表性测试案例的定性性能. 第一栏显示CT图像,并附有相应的地面真实说明。 随后的客户栏显示来自本地模型的预测,这些预测仅限于每个客户端附加说明的任务. 最后一栏显示 FedMust 对所有任务的预测,显示所有任务的分解性能得到改善.

blocks.en: 4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4 读物研究

blocks.en: In this section, we conduct ablation studies to further investigate key aspects of the proposed FedMust framework. Specifically, we examine the utilization of unlabeled data available at participating clients and the possibility of including clients without annotations in the federation.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进行开发研究,以进一步调查拟议的联邦市场框架的关键方面。 具体地说,我们审查了参与的客户对无标签数据的利用情况,以及将没有说明的客户纳入联邦的可能性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Utilization of Unlabeled Client Data
blocks.zh: 4.1 利用未加标签的客户数据

blocks.en: Table 3: Ensembled Dice performance of the models trained using five-fold cross-validation and evaluated on the independent AMOS (top) and TotalSegmentator (bottom) test sets, reported with 95% confidence intervals. This table presents the performance of FedMust using only 60 labeled cases per client under two scenarios: without using local unlabeled data (FedMust) and with local unlabeled data incorporated during student training (FedMust+UL).
blocks.zh: 表3:使用五倍交叉验证方法培训的模型的嵌入性能,并在独立的AMOS(顶部)和TotalSegmentator(底部)测试集上进行评估,报告时置信间隔为95%。 本表列出FedMust在两种情况下只使用每个客户端60个标注的病例的性能:不使用本地无标注数据(FedMust),在学生培训期间包含本地无标注数据(FedMust+UL).

blocks.en: In Section 3.2 , only the available annotated data at each client were used to generate features for all tasks. Subsequently, only this portion of the data was employed during student training. However, in real-world settings, institutions possess a limited amount of annotated data alongside a substantially larger amount of unlabeled data that often remains unused. To examine the potential of leveraging such data, we design this experiment such that each client has partial labels for only 60 cases from its local dataset, while the remaining cases are treated as unlabeled. Consequently, during teacher training, only 60 cases are used for tasks with annotations at each client; however, during student training, features are generated and utilized for the entire available dataset, including both labeled and unlabeled cases. For example, for client C1, as shown in Table 1 , 60 cases are used to train the teacher model, after which the teacher models from all clients are used to generate features for all 131 cases across all tasks.
blocks.zh: 在第3.2节中,只使用了每个客户端现有的附加说明的数据来生成所有任务的特性。 随后,只有这部分数据是在学生培训期间使用的。 然而,在现实世界环境中,各机构拥有的附加说明的数据数量有限,而且大量未加标签的数据往往仍未使用。 为了审查利用这些数据的潜力,我们设计了这一试验,使每个客户端只能从其本地数据集中为60个案例贴上部分标签,而其余案例则作为无标签处理。 因此,在教师培训期间,只有60个案例用于每个客户都有说明的任务;然而,在学生培训期间,所有可用的数据集,包括标有标签和未标有标签的案例,都生成和使用特征。 例如,如表1所示,客户C1有60个案例用于培训教师模式,之后,所有客户的教师模式都用于为所有131个案例生成特性。

blocks.en: The Dice performance of the models trained in this manner is then compared with that of the local models and the corresponding scenario in Section 3.2 . The ensembled performance of the 5-fold cross-validated models and the corresponding confidence intervals, evaluated on the AMOS and TotalSegmentator test sets, are summarized in Table 3 . The results show that incorporating additional unlabeled data from the clients leads to inconsistent performance improvements compared with FedMust. We hypothesize that this inconsistent behavior stems from unreliable teachers that fail to provide meaningful features for the unlabeled data during the early stages of training. This behavior could potentially be mitigated by using pretrained models or extending the initial teacher FL round to start the process with more reliable teachers. The same inconsistent behavior is also observed in the experiment with 20 labeled cases per client, as opposed to the 60 cases considered here, with the corresponding results provided in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 然后,将以这种方式培训的模型的Dice性能与当地模型和3.2节的相应情景进行比较。 表3汇总了在AMOS和TotalSigmentator测试集上评价的5倍跨验证模型的全聚性能和相应的置信间隔。 结果显示,纳入客户提供的更多无标签数据,导致与FedMust相比业绩改进不一致. 我们假设这种不一致的行为 源于不可靠的教师 未能提供有意义的特征 没有标记的数据 在培训初期。 这种行为有可能通过使用预先训练的模型或延长最初的教师FL回合来开始由更可靠的教师来缓解. 在实验中也观察到同样的不一致行为,每个客户有20个标注的案例,而这里考虑的是60个案例,相应的结果在补充材料中提供.

blocks.en: 4.2 Federated Participation Without Annotations
blocks.zh: 4.2 无说明的联邦参与

blocks.en: The traditional FL approach, as well as its recent semi-supervised variants, requires clients to have labeled data for at least one task to participate in the federation. FedMust, however, relaxes this requirement by allowing clients without labeled data to participate in FL and potentially contribute to improved federated performance by utilizing their unlabeled data during student training. To investigate this, we consider a scenario with five clients, four of which are identical to those in the previous setups and use all their available labeled data, while the fifth client uses cases from the TotalSegmentator test set as unlabeled. Consequently, the fifth client participates in the federation exclusively during student training, where the teacher models are used to generate features from its local data, which are subsequently utilized for student training.
blocks.zh: 传统的FL方法及其最近的半监督变体,要求客户拥有至少一项任务的标签数据参加联邦. 然而,FedMust放宽了这一要求,允许没有标签数据的客户参与FL,并有可能通过在学生培训期间使用其无标签数据来帮助改善联邦业绩. 为了调查这一点,我们考虑了一个有5个客户的假想,其中4个客户与之前设置的客户相同,并使用其所有可用的标签数据,而第5个客户则使用TotalSegmentator测试集中的案件作为无标签. 因此,第五个客户只参加学生培训,利用教师模型从当地数据中生成特征,随后用于学生培训。

blocks.en: Table 4: Ensembled Dice performance of models trained using five-fold cross-validation and evaluated on the independent AMOS test set, reported with 95% confidence intervals. FedMust-4C denotes the setting with four clients, each having annotations for a single task. FedMust-5C uses the same four clients with an additional fifth client that has no labeled data and contributes only unlabeled data from the TotalSegmentator dataset.
blocks.zh: 表4:使用五倍交叉验证法培训并在独立的AMOS测试集上评价的模型的嵌入性能,报告的置信间隔为95%. FedMust-4C表示设置有四个客户端,每个客户端都有单项任务的注释. FedMust-5C使用相同的四个客户端,另外还有一个没有标签数据的第五客户端,只提供来自TotalSegmentator数据集的无标签数据.

blocks.en: The trained model is then evaluated by comparing its Dice performance with that of the local model and the corresponding FedMust model using four clients. This comparison isolates the effect of incorporating an unlabeled client into the federation. The ensembled performance of the 5-fold cross-validated models on the AMOS test set, along with the corresponding confidence intervals, is summarized in Table 4 . The models are evaluated only on the AMOS test set, since the data from the fifth client were obtained from the TotalSegmentator cohort, and comparisons with the four-client scenario would not provide a fair comparison due to data leakage. The results indicate that adding a fifth client to the federation does not improve the performance of the existing FL clients, suggesting that augmenting FL training with additional unlabeled data is not necessarily beneficial. This is also shown in the box plots in Fig. 4 , which illustrate model performance across the five cross-validation folds on the AMOS test set. These results further confirm that the inclusion of a fifth client with a large amount of unlabeled data in the FL process does not yield consistent performance improvements compared with the four-client FL scenario. Such inconsistent behavior may be attributed to the imbalance between the amount of unlabeled data available at the fifth client and the data sizes of the other clients.
blocks.zh: 然后通过比较其Dice的性能与本地模型和相应的FedMust模型的性能,利用四个客户端来评价经过训练的模型. 这种比较隔离了将未加标签的客户纳入联邦的影响。 表4汇总了AMOS测试集上5倍跨验证模型的全景性能以及相应的置信间隔。 这些模型只在AMOS测试集上评价,因为来自第五个客户端的数据是从总分层器组获得的,而与四个客户端的假设进行比较并不能提供由于数据泄露而得到的公平比较. 结果显示,联邦增加第五个客户并不能改善现有FL客户的绩效,这表明增加FL培训,增加附加无标签数据不一定有益. 图4中的框图也显示了这一点,该图说明了AMOS测试集上五个交叉验证折叠的模型性能. 这些结果进一步证实,将大量无标签数据的第五个客户纳入FL进程,与四客户FL假想相比,并不能产生一致的性能改进. 这种不一致的行为可能归因于第五客户端可获得的无标签数据数量与其他客户端数据大小之间的不平衡.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Model performance across the five cross-validation folds, evaluated on the AMOS test set. The results show the performance of individual folds rather than the ensembled performance. FedMust-4C denotes the setting with four clients, each having annotations for a single task. FedMust-5C uses the same four clients with an additional fifth client that has no labeled data and contributes only unlabeled data from the TotalSegmentator dataset.
blocks.zh: 图4:跨5个交叉验证折叠的模型性能,在AMOS测试集上评价. 结果显示个人折叠的性能,而不是综艺的性能. FedMust-4C表示设置有四个客户端,每个客户端都有单项任务的注释. FedMust-5C使用相同的四个客户端,另外还有一个没有标签数据的第五客户端,只提供来自TotalSegmentator数据集的无标签数据.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The impact of unlabeled data, whether originating from other clients or from the client itself, on the performance of FedMust requires further clarification. Since the data across clients are only partially labeled, in this scenario, data with annotations for a specific task are considered unlabeled for other clients. For example, when generating features using the Liver teacher, data from C2, C3, and C4 are considered unlabeled, as C1 is the only client with labeled data for the liver task. As shown in Section 3.2 , incorporating such unlabeled data from other clients during student training consistently improves segmentation performance for each task. However, Section 4.1 shows that, when the contribution of unlabeled data from other clients is fixed, additionally incorporating unlabeled data from the clients themselves results in inconsistent performance improvements. A possible explanation for these marginal performance improvements is that leveraging additional local unlabeled data may be beneficial only when the teacher model used to generate the features is capable of providing meaningful feature representations in the first place. To address this limitation, future experiments could initialize the FL process using pretrained models or extend the initial federated round with more local iterations to obtain better-performing teacher models. In addition, the use of foundation models or more sophisticated teacher models that can maintain high performance under limited labeled data requires further investigation in future work.
blocks.zh: 无论是来自其他客户还是客户本身的无标签数据对FedMust的性能的影响需要进一步澄清. 由于跨客户端的数据只有部分标签,在此情景下,带有特定任务说明的数据被视为没有其他客户端的标签. 例如,在使用Liver师生成特性时,来自C2,C3和C4的数据被认为是无标签的,因为C1是肝脏任务唯一有标签数据的客户端. 如第3.2节所示,在学生培训期间纳入其他客户提供的这种无标签的数据,不断提高每项任务的分类性能。 然而,第4.1节显示,当其他客户提供的无标签数据的贡献固定下来时,额外纳入客户自己提供的无标签数据会导致业绩改善不一致。 对这些边际性能改进的一种可能的解释是,只有当用于生成特征的教师模型能够首先提供有意义的特征表述时,利用额外的当地无标签数据才可能有益。 为了解决这一局限性,未来的实验可以使用预先训练过的模型初始化FL过程,或者用更多的局部迭代来延长最初的联邦回合,以获得表现更好的教师模型. 此外,使用基础模型或更精密的教师模型,在有限的标签数据下能够保持高性能,需要在未来的工作中进一步调查.

blocks.en: Unlike the methods proposed in the literature, FedMust allows clients with no labeled data to participate in the federation, as investigated in Section 4.2 . The results show that including an unlabeled client with substantially more data than the labeled data available at the other clients is not, overall, beneficial compared with the four-client setting. However, introducing such an unbalanced amount of unlabeled data into the federation, even under the extreme scenario in which clients have no overlapping sets of labeled tasks, results in a stable trained model with improved performance compared with models trained in isolation. These findings motivate further investigation under more realistic scenarios involving a larger number of clients, overlapping sets of labeled tasks, and a more balanced data distribution. An additional consideration is that FedMust introduces computational overhead due to the training of the student encoder compared with traditional FL approaches. However, given recent advances in computational hardware and the increasing availability of GPUs, this additional computational requirement is not expected to be a major concern.
blocks.zh: 与文献中提议的方法不同,FedMust允许没有标签数据的客户参与联邦,如第4.2节所调查. 结果表明,与其他客户的贴标签数据相比,列入一个没有贴标签的客户端的数据比其他客户端可用的贴标签数据多得多,总体上与四客户端的设置相比没有益处。 然而,在联邦中引入如此不平衡的无标签数据,即使在客户没有重叠的标签任务的极端情景下,结果形成了一个训练有素的稳定的模型,其性能与单独培训的模型相比有所改进。 这些调查结果促使在涉及更多客户的更现实的假想情况下进行进一步调查,重叠的一组标注的任务,以及更平衡的数据分配。 另一个考虑是,FedMust采用了计算间接费用,因为与传统的FL方法相比,培训了学生编码器。 然而,鉴于计算硬件的最近进展以及GPU的可用性日益增加,这一额外的计算要求预计不会成为一个主要关切问题.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This study proposed a semi-supervised federated learning (FL) framework for multi-organ segmentation that, unlike conventional FL algorithms, handles inconsistent label availability across clients. The proposed approach adopted a multi-task student–teacher framework to leverage both labeled and unlabeled data to enhance segmentation performance. The results demonstrated that the proposed framework outperformed the baseline models by leveraging multi-task learning and unlabeled data from other clients. However, incorporating additional unlabeled data from the clients themselves was not consistently beneficial. While the proposed method relaxed the requirement for clients to possess labeled data to participate in FL, the results did not favor the inclusion of an additional client with a large amount of unlabeled data in the federation.
blocks.zh: 本研究提出了多器官分化的半监督联合学习(FL)框架,与常规的FL算法不同,它处理不同客户之间不一致的标签可用性. 拟议的方法采用了一个多任务学生-教师框架,以利用标注和无标注的数据,提高分解性能。 结果表明,拟议框架通过利用来自其他客户的多任务学习和无标签数据,超过了基线模型。 然而,纳入客户自己提供的更多无标签数据并非一贯有益。 虽然拟议方法放宽了客户必须拥有标签数据才能参与FL的要求,但结果不利于在联邦内增加一个拥有大量无标签数据的客户。
